historical_claims.anchor: On February second, nineteen twenty-two, James Joyce's Ulysses appeared in book form in Paris.
historical_claims.source_locator: See cited primary episode or documentary source, with interpretive qualifications in the companion note

historical_claims.anchor: The publisher was Sylvia Beach, an American bookseller whose shop, Shakespeare and Company, had become part of the city's literary life.
historical_claims.source_locator: See cited primary episode or documentary source, with interpretive qualifications in the companion note

historical_claims.anchor: Joyce began writing Ulysses in 1914 and developed it through the following years, largely in Trieste, Zurich, and Paris.
historical_claims.source_locator: See cited primary episode or documentary source, with interpretive qualifications in the companion note

historical_claims.anchor: Before the book appeared, installments were printed in the American magazine The Little Review, beginning in 1918.
